primary_task: Turn a task the owner described or just performed into a new named SKILL.md (with approval gates) and test-run it on the known case.

requirements.name: write a SKILL.md and reference folder
requirements.evidence: Produce a real skill in the same shape as everything else in this plugin: a `SKILL.md` with frontmatter and numbered steps, plus a `reference/` folder

requirements.name: owner's conversation transcript or description
requirements.evidence: If the owner has walked through the task with you ... that transcript is the specification.
requirements.basis: ask_user: 'ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation'

requirements.name: reference/capture.md, reference/skill_authoring.md, reference/gotchas.md
requirements.evidence: Read `reference/capture.md` for how to get a complete picture
requirements.basis: Bundled plugin files; the manifest does not say whether they are in the working directory.

requirements.name: smb-router registration
requirements.evidence: Add it to `smb-router` so plain-English requests reach it
requirements.basis: 'skill: load an installed Claude Code skill, list and search skills and plugins' - the manifest does not say smb-router is installed or editable.

requirements.name: scheduling the new skill
requirements.evidence: If it is a recurring task, offer to schedule it.
requirements.basis: tasks: 'schedule, list and delete cron jobs and wake-ups'

requirements.name: share with the team
requirements.evidence: Offer to share with the team.
requirements.basis: forbid_effects: 'writes_external', 'publishes'; no team-sharing connector is listed ('connectors or integrations other than the tools listed' are lacking). Only an offer, with approval.

requirements.name: connectors the new skill uses (e.g. ERP)
requirements.evidence: A real fallback for when a connector is missing
requirements.basis: Depends on the owner's task; manifest lacks 'connectors or integrations other than the tools listed'.

notes: I took registration, scheduling and sharing as follow-up steps, not part of the core deliverable (the skill file). If Step 6 registration were hard and smb-router absent, it would be BLOCKED. Step 5 test run on the owner's real case could need their external data; unknown.
